\chapter{Return to Two Fictional Dates}
\label{ch:pa-two-date-forms-r4}
\hlchaptermodality{169}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can retrieve two already-taught fictional date examples after a long gap, one at a time, without claiming scored A1 writing or complete mock credit.}

Recall the two previously taught date examples in this form's printed day/month/year order without adding new Punjabi.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{੧੫}/\pa{੦੧}/\pa{੨੦੨੫} (fictional January date A)}{੧੫/੦੧/੨੦੨੫ (fictional January date A)}]{The old fictional date A}

\label{lesson:PA-R169-date-a-again}



\begin{quote}
Look at the closed bank's A card: \textbf{\pa{੧੫}/\pa{੦੧}/\pa{੨੦੨੫}}. The three pieces are day \textbf{\pa{੧੫}}, January month position \textbf{\pa{੦੧}}, and year \textbf{\pa{੨੦੨੫}}. The slash marks keep this form's day/month/year order visible.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Keep A visible. Copy only its day and first slash, then its month and second slash, then its year. Check one box at a time against \textbf{\pa{੧੫}/\pa{੦੧}/\pa{੨੦੨੫}}. No new date or birthday is requested.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Cover A for a moment. Point to its January box, then try the familiar A line once on paper. Uncover the card and repair only the first mismatched box. This is gentle retrieval, not independent scored writing.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\pa{੨੫}/\pa{੦੨}/\pa{੨੦੨੫} (fictional February date B)}{੨੫/੦੨/੨੦੨੫ (fictional February date B)}]{The old fictional date B}

\label{lesson:PA-R169-date-b-again}



\begin{quote}
Look at \textbf{\pa{੨੫}/\pa{੦੨}/\pa{੨੦੨੫}}. B has day \textbf{\pa{੨੫}} and February month position \textbf{\pa{੦੨}}; the familiar year \textbf{\pa{੨੦੨੫}} stays the same as A. The two slashes still divide day, month, and year.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
With B visible, copy \textbf{\pa{੨੫}}, then \textbf{\pa{੦੨}}, then \textbf{\pa{੨੦੨੫}}, placing one slash between each pair of boxes. Compare your line with \textbf{\pa{੨੫}/\pa{੦੨}/\pa{੨੦੨੫}}. If a box differs, repair just that box before moving on.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Hide B for a few seconds. From the old cue “fictional date B,” try its day and month boxes once, then uncover the card and check. The visible model remains available for repair; no independent mock score is assigned.
\end{tcolorbox}
